title.en: An Act to Define the Status of the Junior College of Liberal Arts of the University of the Philippines in the Municipality of Cebu, Cebu, and Appropriating Funds for Its Maintenance and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The branch College of Liberal Arts of the University of the Philippines, otherwise known as the
Junior College of Cebu and located in the municipality of Cebu, Cebu, is hereby declared to be a permanent
branch of said University, and the funds for the operation and maintenance thereof shall be provided by the
Philippine Legislature. The administration and operation of said College shall continue as heretofore in the
hands of the Board of Regents of the University of the Philippines, in accordance with the Organic Law of
said University.

To carry out the purposes of this Act, the sum of ten thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out
of any funds in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, for the operating expenses of said branch of
the University of the Philippines for the remainder of the fiscal year nineteen hundred and thirty-five. In the
succeeding years the operating expenses thereof in the amount of thirty thousand pesos shall be included in
the annual appropriation for the University of the Philippines in the General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 10, 1935.
